name: MonarchCountrySelect
title: CountrySelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (a .sheet with a List and .searchable) over the ISO 3166-1 codes, with names from Locale.localizedString(forRegionCode:)
summary: A searchable picker for an ISO 3166-1 country or territory, with names in the reader's language, codes and flags.
whenToUse: For a country in an address, billing or profile form, where the list is long and people search by name or code.
whenNotToUse: Not for the calling code of a phone number; use MonarchPhoneCountrySelect. For a handful of countries, use a Picker with .pickerStyle(.menu).
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<String?>, prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, countries: [String]? = nil, excluded: [String] = [], priority: [String] = [], locale: Locale? = nil, showsFlag: Bool = true, showsCode: Bool = true, isRequired: Bool = false, isClearable: Bool = true, labels: MonarchCountrySelectLabels = MonarchCountrySelectLabels(), countryName: (@Sendable (String) -> String?)? = nil)
static func flag(for code: String) -> String
struct MonarchCountrySelectLabels { init(suggested: String? = nil, all: String? = nil, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels()) }

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It names the field and the sheet.

options.name: selection
options.description: The chosen ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Any case is read; the picker writes upper case. nil when nothing is chosen.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: countries
options.description: Limits the list to these codes. nil lists the 249 codes of countryCodes.

options.name: priority
options.description: Codes listed first under Suggested while nothing is typed. Codes not in the list are ignored.

options.name: locale
options.description: The language of the names and the sort order. The environment's locale when nil.

options.name: showsFlag
options.description: Shows each country's flag emoji at the end of its row.

options.name: showsCode
options.description: Shows each country's code at the end of its row.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds Required to the hint.

options.name: isClearable
options.description: Shows a clear button in the field while a country is chosen.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces Suggested, All countries and the combobox strings; the combobox's empty text is built in as No countries match.

options.name: countryName
options.description: Replaces a country's name, for a product's legal wording. Return nil to keep Foundation's name.

states.name: empty
states.description: The field shows the prompt in the subtle text colour.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The field shows the country's name and a clear button.

states.name: suggestions
states.description: With priority and nothing typed, the list has a Suggested section and an All countries section.

states.name: searching
states.description: The suggestions are hidden; matches are listed with names that start with the query first.

states.name: no match
states.description: The list reads No countries match.

states.name: error
states.description: The field border and message use the danger colour, with an icon; the error is announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Label, value and border use the disabled roles; the sheet does not open.

appearance: The field is MonarchCombobox's: the input background, the input border (danger with an error) and the default text colour for the name. In the list, the code and flag are a muted caption at the end of each row and the chosen row has an accent check mark. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Names come from Foundation, so they can differ in wording from the web's Intl.DisplayNames and from Android. The list of codes is bundled (the same 249 as the web) instead of Locale.Region.isoRegions, which also lists continents and reserved codes and changes between OS versions. MonarchComboboxOption has no slot for an emoji before the label, so the flag is shown at the end of the row with the code rather than before the name as on the web. The web's uncontrolled defaultValue and onValueChange are the binding on iOS. The list opens in a sheet, as every MonarchCombobox does.
accessibility: The field is a button labelled with the label, whose value is the chosen country's name or None.
The help text, the error (read as Error: ...) and Required are the field's hint; a new error is announced.
Each row is one button read with the name, then the code and the flag emoji as VoiceOver names it.
The chosen row has the selected trait and a check mark, not colour alone.
Rows and the field are at least 44 points high.
edgeCases: A selection that is not in countries is still listed first, so its name shows in the field.
Lower-case codes in selection, countries, excluded and priority are read as upper case.
A code Foundation does not know shows the code itself as the name.
Searching for several words needs every word, so 'south ko' finds South Korea.
In a language other than English, the English name is searched too.

examples.title: Suggested countries first
examples.template:
MonarchCountrySelect(
    {{label}},
    selection: $country,
    prompt: {{placeholder}},
    helper: "Stored as " + (country ?? "nothing yet") + ".",
    priority: [{{priority.0}}, {{priority.1}}, {{priority.2}}]
)
examples.code:
MonarchCountrySelect(
    "Billing country",
    selection: $country,
    prompt: "Search by name or code",
    helper: "Stored as " + (country ?? "nothing yet") + ".",
    priority: ["GB", "IN", "US"]
)

examples.title: A limited list in French without flags
examples.code:
MonarchCountrySelect(
    "Pays de livraison",
    selection: $country,
    countries: ["FR", "BE", "CH", "LU"],
    locale: Locale(identifier: "fr_FR"),
    showsFlag: false
)
